mechanism: Metoclopramide may increase gastric motility and absorption variability of torsemide, while torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium) increases risk of metoclopramide-associated tardive dyskinesia and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, maintain adequate potassium and magnesium levels, and consider alternative antiemetics; limit metoclopramide use to short-term therapy (≤3 months) due to tardive dyskinesia risk.
